entries.title: Joshua 19:1
segments: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, for the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families. And their inheritance was inside the inheritance of the sons of Judah.

entries.title: Joshua 19:2
segments: And they [had] in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

entries.title: Joshua 19:3
segments: and Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

entries.title: Joshua 19:4
segments: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

entries.title: Joshua 19:5
segments: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

entries.title: Joshua 19:6
segments: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages--

entries.title: Joshua 19:7
segments: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages,

entries.title: Joshua 19:8
segments: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramah of the south. This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:9
segments: The inheritance of the sons of Simeon [was] out of the portion of the sons of Judah. For the part of the sons of Judah [was] too much for them; therefore the sons of Simeon had their inheritance within their inheritance.

entries.title: Joshua 19:10
segments: And the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun according to their families. And the border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

entries.title: Joshua 19:11
segments: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that [is] before Jokneam,

entries.title: Joshua 19:12
segments: and turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of The Flames of Tabor, and then goes out to Daberath, and goes up to Japhia,

entries.title: Joshua 19:13
segments: and from there it passes on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goes out to Rimmon-methoar, to Neah.

entries.title: Joshua 19:14
segments: And the border compasses it on the north side to Hannathon. And its edges were [in] the valley of Jiphthahel,

entries.title: Joshua 19:15
segments: and Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem; twelve cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:16
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the sons of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:17
segments: The fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the sons of Issachar according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:18
segments: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

entries.title: Joshua 19:19
segments: and Hapharaim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,

entries.title: Joshua 19:20
segments: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

entries.title: Joshua 19:21
segments: and Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

entries.title: Joshua 19:22
segments: And the border reaches to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh. And the edges of their border were at Jordan; sixteen cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:23
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:24
segments: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:25
segments: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

entries.title: Joshua 19:26
segments: and Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reaches to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

entries.title: Joshua 19:27
segments: and turns toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reaches to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goes out to Cabul on the left hand,

entries.title: Joshua 19:28
segments: and Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, to great Sidon;

entries.title: Joshua 19:29
segments: and the border turns to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre. And the border turns to Hosah, and the boundaries of it are at the sea from the line to Achzib,

entries.title: Joshua 19:30
segments: and Ummah, and Aphek, and Rehob; twenty-two cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:31
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:32
segments: The sixth lot came out to the sons of Naphtali, for the sons of Naphtali according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:33
segments: And their border was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakum. And its boundaries were at Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 19:34
segments: And the border turns west toward Aznoth-tabor, and goes out from there to Hukkok, and reached to Zebulun on the south side, and reaches to Asher on the west side, and to Judah on Jordan toward the sunrise.

entries.title: Joshua 19:35
segments: And the fortified cities [are] Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

entries.title: Joshua 19:36
segments: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

entries.title: Joshua 19:37
segments: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

entries.title: Joshua 19:38
segments: and Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:39
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:40
segments: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 19:41
segments: And the border of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

entries.title: Joshua 19:42
segments: and Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

entries.title: Joshua 19:43
segments: and Elon, and Timnah, and Ekron,

entries.title: Joshua 19:44
segments: and Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

entries.title: Joshua 19:45
segments: and Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gath-rimmon,

entries.title: Joshua 19:46
segments: and Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

entries.title: Joshua 19:47
segments: And the border of the sons of Dan came out [too little] for them. And the sons of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived in it. And [they] called Leshem Dan, after the name of their father Dan.

entries.title: Joshua 19:48
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, by their families, these cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 19:49
segments: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their borders, the sons of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

entries.title: Joshua 19:50
segments: According to the command of Jehovah they gave him the city which he asked, Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim. And he built the city and lived in it.

entries.title: Joshua 19:51
segments: These [are] the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Jehovah, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. And they finished dividing the land.
